policy_text: Employees are entitled to 18 paid annual leave days per calendar year.
Annual leave must be requested through the HR portal using the Annual Leave Request Form.
Employees should normally submit annual leave requests at least 3 working days before the intended leave date.
Annual leave may be taken in half-day increments.
Up to 5 unused annual leave days may be carried forward to the following calendar year. Carry-forward days expire after the following calendar year.
Eligible unused annual leave may be encashed at separation, subject to company policy and applicable rules.
key_rule: Eligibility is determined during separation processing.

policy_text: A manager may decline or request a different leave date when there is a genuine operational requirement.
Eligible unused annual leave is handled during separation according to the leave encashment policy.
key_rule: Final treatment is determined during separation processing.

policy_text: Employees receive 10 paid sick leave days per calendar year.
Sick leave should be recorded through the HR portal as soon as reasonably possible.
key_rule: Notify the company and record the absence in the HR portal.

policy_text: A medical certificate is required when sick leave exceeds 2 consecutive working days.
key_rule: Medical certificate required after 2 consecutive working days.

policy_text: If an employee becomes suddenly ill and cannot apply beforehand, they should notify their manager as soon as reasonably possible and record the sick leave when able.
key_rule: Prompt notification is required where practical.

policy_text: Sick leave may be taken in half-day increments.
Unused sick leave does not carry forward to the next calendar year.
Unpaid leave may be requested when paid leave has been exhausted or for a genuine personal reason, subject to approval.
key_rule: Paid leave should generally be exhausted first, unless HR approves otherwise.

policy_text: Employees must submit an Unpaid Leave Request Form through the HR portal and obtain the required manager and HR approvals.
Approval depends on the reason, operational impact, available paid leave, and manager and HR review.
Salary is reduced in proportion to approved unpaid leave days.
key_rule: Unpaid days are unpaid and reduce salary accordingly.

policy_text: Eligible employees may receive 16 weeks of paid parental leave.
Employees who have completed 6 months of continuous employment are eligible following birth, adoption, or placement of a child.
Employees should normally submit parental leave requests 30 days in advance where reasonably possible.
key_rule: 30 days' advance notice where reasonably possible.

policy_text: HR may request reasonable supporting documentation relating to birth, adoption, or placement.
Parental leave may be taken continuously or in up to two blocks, subject to HR approval.
Eligible parental leave is paid for up to 16 weeks under company policy.
Different leave types may be combined where each leave type's eligibility and approval requirements are met.
key_rule: Each leave type must independently satisfy its requirements.

policy_text: Unapproved absence may be treated as unauthorized absence and may affect attendance records and pay, subject to company procedures.
key_rule: Approval should be obtained before leave except in genuine emergencies.

policy_text: Employees can view their current leave balance in the HR portal.
key_rule: Check the HR portal for the current balance.

policy_text: Employees should contact their reporting manager for approval questions and HR Operations for policy or system questions.
For urgent leave, employees should notify their reporting manager as soon as possible and submit the appropriate leave request through the HR portal when practical.
Employees may receive up to 5 paid working days of bereavement leave following the death of an immediate family member.
Bereavement leave applies to the death of an immediate family member, including a spouse, parent, child, sibling, or legal guardian.
Employees should notify their manager as soon as reasonably possible and submit the Bereavement Leave Form when practical.
key_rule: Prompt notification; documentation may be requested.
